title: Engagement Scope
description: Defines the authorized scope, mode, and permissions for a red team engagement. Validated by every agent before any operation.

authorized_by.description: Email of the authorizing security owner

mode.description: Operating mode — controls what agents are permitted to do. 'external-active-testing' additionally unlocks the External Vulnerability Agent (EVA) active tiers; it must be paired with an enabled, authorized external_testing block.

resource_groups.description: Resource group names, or ['*'] for all

resource_types.description: Optional ARM resource-type allow-list to bound a large estate, e.g. ['microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines']. Case-insensitive; a trailing '/*' matches a whole provider (e.g. 'microsoft.compute/*'). Empty/omitted means all in-scope types. Filtering is applied server-side in Azure Resource Graph (see knowledge/scaling.md).

domains.description: Optional assessment-domain allow-list (maps to the domain sub-agents). Lets an operator target e.g. identity + data + public exposure across the whole estate and defer the long tail. Empty/omitted means all domains.

scale.description: Optional scale controls for large deployments (thousands of resources per subscription). Bounds the expensive per-resource tail without sacrificing the cheap server-side ARG census. See knowledge/scaling.md for the full execution contract.

sample_per_type.description: Max resources of a single type to subject to expensive per-resource (data-plane) checks. 0 or omitted = no sampling cap (full census). ARG-only checks always run against the full census regardless of this value.

max_resource_calls.description: Hard ceiling on the total number of per-resource control-plane/data-plane 'az' calls across the engagement. The bounded fan-out helper stops scheduling new per-resource calls once this budget is exhausted and records the remainder as skipped-by-budget in the coverage matrix.

time_budget_min.description: Soft wall-clock budget in minutes. The orchestrator prioritizes highest-risk work first and marks unreached work as skipped-by-budget rather than aborting.

prioritize_exposed.description: When true, rank per-resource candidates by exposure (public IP / internet-facing / privileged / prod-tagged) so the highest-risk resources are assessed first within any sampling or time budget. Recommended true for large estates.

concurrency.description: Max concurrent per-resource 'az' calls in the bounded fan-out helper. Keep low enough to stay under ARM/ARG throttling across all fanned-out agents (see knowledge/scaling.md). Defaults to a conservative value when omitted.

max_arg_pages.description: Safety cap on the number of 1,000-row ARG pages a single paged check will fetch before recording the result as partial. Guards against a runaway check on a pathologically large type. Omit for the tool default.

external_testing.description: Active external vulnerability testing (the External Vulnerability Agent, EVA). OFF by default. Active tiers send REAL traffic to live endpoints and therefore require all of: mode 'external-active-testing', enabled: true, and a completed authorization block. Targets are ALWAYS restricted to the Azure-derived allowlist (engagements/<session>/scope/external-targets.json) built from in-scope inventory — never free-form internet hosts. A fail-closed egress guardrail enforces this at the tool layer.

enabled.description: Master switch. Must be true (with mode external-active-testing and a valid authorization block) before any active tier runs. Default false.

tier.description: Maximum intrusiveness. safe-active = benign GET/HEAD probes (security headers, TLS/ciphers, HTTP methods, cookie flags, CORS, exposed paths) via the built-in dependency-free prober. active-dast = OSS scanners (nuclei / OWASP ZAP / nikto / whatweb / testssl.sh). exploit-validation = sqlmap and confirmed injection/XSS payloads (most intrusive, hardest gate).

authorization.description: Written authorization (rules of engagement) for active testing. All fields must be populated before any active tier runs.

attested_by.description: Name/email of the person authorizing active external testing.

authorized_window_start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — start of the authorized testing window.

authorized_window_end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — end of the authorized testing window.

target_confirmation.description: When true, a human must confirm the generated target allowlist before any active tier fires.

static_analysis.description: Extended, fully-offline static analysis (SAST) of website code pulled from Azure (App Service Kudu / Storage $web). Separate gate from live testing; sends no traffic to the target.

enabled.description: Default false. Independent of the live-testing tier.

limits.description: Intensity caps so active testing cannot impact production availability.

tools.description: Which open-source scanners EVA may orchestrate when present on PATH (each still scope-locked to the allowlist).
